summary: Frontend-only verification of TaskDrawer header bug fix. Logged in as owner, opened 'Bisiklet Festivali 2026' -> clicked task card -> task-drawer opened. Verified 'Sil' (delete-task-btn) and Radix close X buttons are both visible, non-overlapping (24px horizontal gap: delete right=1864, close left=1888), and each independently clickable: X closes drawer without deleting; Sil deletes the task (task count 4 -> 3). Regression: drawer shows title, status, priority, assignees, due date, visibility, tags, description, checklist, subtasks, attachments, comments. No page errors.

issues: Console warns: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Not blocking; consider adding VisuallyHidden DialogTitle/Description for a11y.

other.issue: WebSocket /api/ws/... returns 403 during handshake on page load (console error). Not related to this fix but may affect realtime features.

action_items: Optional: silence Radix a11y warnings by adding VisuallyHidden DialogTitle/Description where missing.
Investigate WebSocket 403 handshake (auth/token validation on ws endpoint).
critical_code_review_comments: TaskDrawer.jsx header spacing (mr-8 on delete-task-btn) correctly avoids collision with Radix auto close X.
TaskDrawer.jsx is 453 lines — consider splitting subtasks/checklist/comments into subcomponents for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None. Test deleted one task ('Katılımcı kayıt sistemini aç') from Bisiklet Festivali 2026 project as part of Sil verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TaskDrawer header fix verified. Note: test deleted the 'Katılımcı kayıt sistemini aç' task from 'Bisiklet Festivali 2026'; if future tests rely on it, reseed. Radix a11y console warnings and WS 403 exist but are out of scope of this bug.
rca of the issue: Original overlap: SheetHeader had delete button flush with SheetContent's absolutely-positioned Radix close X (right-4). Fix: added mr-8 to delete-task-btn so its right edge stops well before the X. Verified bbox: delete right=1864, X left=1888, gap 24px.
